mapper.select: SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT request_hash FROM dsvp_request_snapshots WHERE id = #{traceId}

SELECT s.request_hash AS requestHash, s.animation_record_id AS animationRecordId, s.source_type AS sourceType, s.source_ref AS sourceRef, a.chapter_id AS chapterId, a.user_id AS userId FROM dsvp_request_snapshots s LEFT JOIN animation_records a ON a.id = s.animation_record_id WHERE s.id = #{traceId}

SELECT COALESCE(s.chapter_id_snapshot, cscript.chapter_id) AS chapter_id FROM classroom_sessions s JOIN classroom_scripts cscript ON cscript.id = s.script_id JOIN chapters c ON c.id = COALESCE(s.chapter_id_snapshot, cscript.chapter_id) WHERE s.id = #{sessionId} AND s.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED'

SELECT m.id AS presentationId, m.chapter_id AS chapterId, p.source_ref AS sourceRef, r.license_scope AS licenseScope FROM presentation_pages p JOIN presentation_manifests m ON m.id = p.manifest_id JOIN chapters c ON c.id = m.chapter_id LEFT JOIN resources r ON r.id = m.resource_id WHERE p.id = #{pageId} AND p.review_status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'VERIFIED') AND m.review_status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'VERIFIED') AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND (r.id IS NULL OR r.review_status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'VERIFIED'))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chapters WHERE id = #{chapterId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'

SELECT r.id, r.chapter_id AS chapterId, r.license_scope AS licenseScope FROM resources r JOIN chapters c ON c.id = r.chapter_id WHERE r.id = #{sourceRef} AND r.resource_type = 'ANIMATION' AND r.review_status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'VERIFIED') AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED'
